scope: Complete assigned historical content spans; recorded claims and proof boundaries reviewed, not contemporary runtime or source-canon validation

rows.mechanism_and_interactions: The historical worker checkpoint records a wiki-digest pass preserving edition boundaries: Stealth Boy has base camouflage, side effects, and distinct Mark II/III, Phantom and Railroad variants; power armor is a frame/core/part system with edition-specific training and vehicle-like use, while AT-0M scanning/mind field is tabletop-only. Drug summaries distinguish base effects, strains/recipes, addiction, withdrawal and treatment; Jet’s production-origin conflict remains unresolved. Fallout stat and combat summaries separate classic, later-game and tabletop formulas, including classic sequential DT/DR, New Vegas DR/DT and later nonlinear mitigation. Skills can gate specific actions or authored dialogue, while overview pages often omit formulas or defer to edition-specific child pages. These are recorded source summaries, not implemented game mechanics.
rows.disposition: Historical documentation delivery reports completed reads for full pages and retained mechanic spans, generally with frozen-manifest hash matches. Entries explicitly mark limited retained spans, dependency pages, text inconsistencies, scope-review flags and source-version conflicts. Completion describes checkpointed digest coverage; it does not independently verify the wiki claims, canon, current project rules or implemented behavior.
rows.owner_or_consumer: docs/research/power-systems/wiki-digests/full-dumps/workers/fallout-full/CHECKPOINT.md; specific edition/model child pages are named as dependencies but their paths are not supplied in this span.
rows.evidence_state: Only the assigned historical checkpoint lines were reviewed. Its read/hash statements and mechanic summaries are reported evidence, not direct inspection of underlying wiki pages, the frozen manifest, source canon or current runtime.
rows.remaining_check: If a summary is reused, inspect its specific edition/model source page and resolve its recorded dependency or conflict, including the Jet origin disagreement, incomplete Fallout 76 formulas and scope-review flags. Then establish the selected world mechanism and consumer independently.

cross_record_findings: The checkpoint describes secondary wiki notes and worker read receipts. A reported complete read/hash validates the capture workflow, not the accuracy of the notes, franchise canon or a project mechanic.

Edition and format boundaries materially change the summarized systems: classic, later-game, Tactics, tabletop and canceled-project material are kept distinct, with child pages and conflicts left open where the overview cannot support an exact rule.
No implementation or present runtime evidence is recorded here; any future mechanic needs its selected source page and actual in-world consumer checked separately.
